about:
Components Corporation operates from Denville, New Jersey. The company was founded by Jerry B. Minter, who served as its president, and has been producing printed circuit test points for over 60 years. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the business built its early reputation on the TP Series of test points and later expanded into a broader range of wireform interconnect products.

The company designs, manufactures, and engineers precision printed circuit test points, wireform interconnect and testing devices, card edge connectors, preform jumpers, battery contacts, and related hardware. Its product portfolio includes test points (including silver-plated and color-coded versions), card edge connectors such as the DIGI-KLIP® series, PC mount wireforms, sockets, shunts, headers, fuse clips, and circuit card guides. Components Corporation also offers custom wireform manufacturing, using proprietary technology to meet specific customer requirements. The firm serves orders of any quantity, from prototype to production volumes.

Components Corporation serves customers in medical devices, security electronics, industrial electronics, military, commercial, consumer, and aerospace sectors. Its components are used in mission-critical applications across these industries. The company reaches markets through a worldwide network of certified distributors and regional manufacturing sales representatives, enabling delivery across the United States and internationally.

The company states that its differentiation lies in a "no failure" credo, a commitment to customer satisfaction, and the ability to provide custom wireform solutions tailored to unique needs. It emphasizes high-quality, innovative products and exemplary customer service as reasons clients return. All parts are manufactured to be RoHS and REACH compliant, meeting Directive 2015/863/EU and EU Regulation EC 1907/2006.
